designDelta.oldValue: The local WebDAV Phone shell inherited generic settings geometry and did not explicitly bind the source 390x844 master.
designDelta.newValue: The route uses a scoped 390x844 WebDAV frame without a page-surface shadow.

designDelta.oldValue: At 760px the local route used the generic expanded-width shell at 760x980 with a nested 560x892 panel.
designDelta.newValue: Only the WebDAV route resolves to the canonical 760x960 Tablet master; landscape remains its Tablet alias.

designDelta.oldValue: The local overview exposed timeout, Wi-Fi and schedule values that belong in Advanced settings rather than the Figma source overview.
designDelta.newValue: The overview now follows the source grid: 已连接, 最近测试 10:30, 远程备份 8 个, 同步目录 /ReaderBackup.

designDelta.oldValue: Test/Save actions fell through the generic settings overlay, whose copy, terminal controls and geometry differed from the canonical ActionDialog variants.
designDelta.newValue: The existing WebDAV owner now drives the exact 12 live Figma Test/Save/Clear variants. The 304x160, r8, shadowless dialog has source copy and paired controls.

designDelta.oldValue: The demo helper settled Test and Save in the next event loop, making the existing Figma Loading variants imperceptible after a real click.
designDelta.newValue: A user-triggered Test or Save keeps its already-designed Loading variant visible for 320ms before the existing owner resolves; reducer/unit helper defaults remain unchanged.

acceptance.viewportPolicy: Landscape aliases Tablet. No Compact, Fold, or independent landscape master was introduced.
geometryAndTypography: Real browser inspection at 390x844: route root and WebDAV frame are exactly 390x844; the settled ActionDialog is x=43, y=342, 304x160.
Real browser inspection at 760x960: route root and WebDAV frame are exactly 760x960; the settled ActionDialog is x=228, y=400, 304x160.
The dialog uses 18px padding, 10px rhythm, 24/40/38px content rows, 128px paired controls, r8 and no box-shadow, matching the current canonical component.
Overview values and their icon intent match the current configured Figma master; advanced controls remain right-aligned in their existing source-backed rows.
interaction: Real browser click/keyboard checks proved input editing, SSL switch click and Space, timeout stepper, Test and Save opening, visible Loading, Success, closing and deterministic focus return.
Test and Save first validate the existing four inputs. Invalid input exposes the existing aria-invalid state and does not open a dialog.
The automatic-sync row deliberately remains inert: current Figma exposes no option list/value nodes, so the local backport does not invent a selector or mutate its value.
The generic settingsOverlay owner is blocked for webdav-config; the WebDAV owner alone owns its dialog state, guards and async completion.

evidenceCommitStrategy: This evidence-only file binds implementation commit 0adf9da774c6615946b80558a56d56cdf4005e16. It does not overwrite the historical F2 Design Delta or F0 Crosswalk.
boundary: This is a local-only backport of the current Figma WebDAV master and directly instantiated ActionDialog variants. It does not write Figma, alter preserved Figma pages/components/reactions, create detached frames, redefine UiEvent/reducer/route ownership, enter Motion Reference, change Search/Sync Backup, or change any native client. The connector cannot expose the official current Figma revision after the live node reads, so no current revision is fabricated.
